3969.title: Browser session CLI forwards machine names as host IDs
3969.rootCauseOneLine: The plugin CLI forwards a machine name into hostId without resolving it before session creation and host RPC.
3969.proposedFix: Resolve CLI machine selectors to canonical host IDs before dispatch; reject missing and ambiguous names.
3969.caveats: In-process plugin reproduction; live daemon heartbeat and recurring cleanup warnings were not tested. Regression patch and exact outputs are inline in the HTML; raw artifacts remain local under site policy.
